description.zh: 节点在被添加或恢复后，是否自动加入集群并开始提供服务
description.en: Specifies whether a node automatically joins the cluster and starts providing services after it is added or recovered.
The region ID of the instance.

descriptions.zh: 在 PolarDB-X 中，除了默认的主地址（Primary Endpoint）和只读地址（Read-only Endpoint）外，用户还可以创建自定义地址（Custom Endpoint），用于实现更灵活的读写分离、负载均衡或业务隔离策略。ModifyCustomEndpoint 接口允许你动态调整这些自定义地址的属性，而无需重启实例。
descriptions.en: In PolarDB-X, in addition to the default primary endpoint and read-only endpoint, you can create custom endpoints to implement more flexible read/write splitting, load balancing, or business isolation strategies. The ModifyCustomEndpoint operation allows you to dynamically adjust the attributes of these custom endpoints without restarting the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx modify-custom-endpoint --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name mydatabase --custom-endpoint-id cep-002 --name secondary-endpoint --node-ids node3 --node-auto-enter true --node-role master --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardbx ModifyCustomEndpoint --region cn-hangzhou --CustomEndpointId 'cep-002' --NodeRole master --NodeIds node3 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBInstanceName mydatabase --Name 'secondary-endpoint' --NodeAutoEnter true
